rowCountQueries: snapshots and children grouped by status and org_id
preflight.expectedAffectedRows: Trigger and policy replacement only; zero publication rows changed

execution.resumeStrategy: Transactional function, trigger, and same-table policy replacement; retry whole migration
execution.idempotency: CREATE OR REPLACE plus DROP/CREATE trigger and policy pairs converge to one definition

quarantine.strategy: No data movement; unresolved ownership blocks isolated acceptance

constraintsAndIndexes.validationPlan: Verify committed snapshots and children reject mutation while drafts retain authorized edits

recovery.rollback: Replace guards/policies with the last reviewed definitions; never remove publication rows
recovery.forwardFix: Ship narrower corrected guards in a later additive migration

queries: trigger/policy inventory and draft-versus-committed mutation matrix
